 Bolex Reporter, Volume 6
 Christmas 1955
 Volume 6, Number 1
 Articles: "Make it a Bolex Movie Christmas", Peggy Thompson; "Actors Screen Test with Bolex", Pat Sexton; "Better Movies with Kern Paillard Lenses", Ernst Wildi; "Simple Animation Techniques: Part Two", Peter Gibbons; "The New Pan Cinor 70 at the Summit", Robert Hess; "Rock-a-bye Baby and Bolex", Mary Eleanor Browning; "Bolex Factory Service", Charles Huettenmoser
 Robert Hess, a CBS news film photographer, discusses using the new Pan Cinor 70 zoom lens while filming footage of the Big Four Summit in Geneva.
 32 pages
 Spring 1956
 Volume 6, Number 2
 Articles: "How to film your Best Girl with Bolex", Ernst Wildi; "Titling Your Bolex Eight Millimeter Movies", Peter Gibbons; "Bolex for Car Safety Research", A.J. White; "Movie Making for 'Teen Agers", Peter Rauch; "Time Your Movies", Raymond Baran
 "Movie Making for 'Teen Agers" is a story about a group of Bronx kids who make short films with their Bolex H-8. The author, Peter Rauch, was one of the young members of the group. It's a really entertaining article and makes me wonder whatever happened to them or the films they made.
 32 pages
 Summer 1956
 Volume 6, Number 3
 Articles: "Bolex Stars in Hollywood", Thomas H. Elwell; "The Naked Sea", Allen H. Miner; "How Bolex helped me in Hollywood", Pat Sexton; "Gloria and Gene", Gene Lester; "Bolex Confidential", Irvin Kersher; "Walt Disney, the Sixteen MM King", Joe Reddy
 Doris Day is featured on the cover of this Hollywood themed issue of the Bolex Reporter. It focuses mainly on some of the current Bolex users in Hollywood; stars such as Bob Hope, Bing Crosby, Gary Cooper, Doris Day, Dorothy McGuire, Kim Novak and others. Pat Sexton tells the story of how Bolex helped launch his career in Hollywood.
 32 pages
 Fall 1956
 Volume 6, Number 4
 Articles: "Maintaining Bolex Supremacy", Charles Huettenmoser; "How to Hollywood Edit your Bolex Movies", Peter Gibbons; "Bolex Service", Charles Huettenmoser; "Marlinspike Movie Making", Ray Jewell; "Doing the Impossible Immediately", Mark Steven
 Charles Huettenmoser explains the benefits of the patented "Registrator Claw", or double claw registration in the Bolex H-16 Supreme and later H models. Kim Novak appears on the cover, with her B-8 camera.
 32 pages
